description.text: The third Trick or Trade BOOster Bundle, out on 30 August 2024: 35 mini packs of three cards, one of them holo. Its 30 cards are reprints from six Scarlet & Violet expansions, Paldea Evolved to Twilight Masquerade, each keeping its number with the Pikachu jack-o'-lantern stamped on the bottom right of its picture. All ten holos are cosmos holo: Darkrai, Pikachu, Mimikyu, Gengar, Flutter Mane, Sinistcha, Teal Mask Ogerpon, Munkidori, Fezandipiti and Okidogi. The packs are not random: each is one of ten fixed packs with no card in common, so ten packs make the whole set.
